childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_image_alt: Uba ko uwa yana rike da jariri yana kallonsa
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_1: Lokacin da aka haifi jarirai, ganinsu yana da rauni. A takaice suna kama da 'makafi'. Amma ganinsu zai ci gaba da bunkasa cikin shekaru 5 zuwa 8 masu zuwa, kuma mafi yawan sauyi yana faruwa a watanni 18 na farko na rayuwa. Wannan lokaci ne mai matukar muhimmanci.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_2: A wannan lokaci tsarin gani na idanu da kwakwalwa dole ne ya kasance lafiya kuma yana samun motsawa. Wannan ne mafi kyawun lokaci don gano cuta da tura mara lafiya domin magani.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_brain_image_alt: Idanu da hanyoyin gani da ke hade su da kwakwalwa
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_titl: Dalilin da yadda muke gano cuta domin kara bunkasa gani sosai
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_body: Duk wata cuta ta ido ko kwakwalwa za ta rage bunkasa kuma ta iyakance gani na dogon lokaci. Shi ya sa yana da muhimmanci a gano da wuri-wuri duk wasu dalilan cuta masu magani da ke shafar bunkasar gani da kuma bunkasar jiki gaba daya.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_question_bubble: Ana iya yin hakan ta hanyar tambayar game da gani, ciki, haihuwa, kowace rashin lafiya da kuma bunkasa gaba daya
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_observe_copy: Sai a lura da idanu domin tantance bunkasar gani, sannan a yi gwajin fundal 'red' reflex da kuma duba gaban ido domin binciken cututtukan ido
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_paragr: A cikin mahaifa, jaririn da ke cikin ciki yana kewaye da sauti mai laushi da kwantar da hankali, ciki har da bugun zuciyar mahaifiyarsu da murya da sauti daga duniyar waje.
Yayin da ciki ya kai matakin ƙarshe, idanun jariri na iya buɗewa a cikin mahaifar.
Yayin da har yanzu ba su iya ganin hotuna ko cikakkun bayanai ba, suna iya ganin canje-canje a cikin haske.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_image_: Misalin matakin ciki na jaririn da ba a haifa ba a cikin mahaifa
Misalin matakin ciki na ƙarshen ciki yana nuna wayewar haske
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_2_paragr: A lokacin haihu, hangen nesa ba kamar na manya ba ne. Jariri 'makaho' ne da rashin kyawun gani na kusan 6/600. Ba sa tsinkayar launi da yawa kuma suna da ƙarancin hankali. Ba su da stereovision kuma idanunsu na iya lumshe ido akai-akai.
Duk da haka za su kalli fuska kai tsaye a kusa da kusa, kuma su matse idanunsu zuwa haske mai haske. Tunaninsu daga yanzu zai yi girma da sauri kuma ya zama kamar manya da shekaru 8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_3_paragr: A cikin makonni biyu hangen nesa ya inganta sosai. Yanzu suna iya ganin wasu daki-daki, musamman idan abubuwa suna kusa. Babu launi kuma abin da suke gani yana kwance, saboda har yanzu idanunsu ba su miƙe ba kuma suna aiki tare don zurfin fahimta.
Wani lokaci idanunsu za su shuɗe ciki ko waje na ɗan lokaci kaɗan. Ana kiran wannan squinting. Wannan ya kamata a daina faruwa da watanni uku.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_3_image_: Misalin ci gaban gani na makonni biyu
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_paragr: A wata daya hangen nesa launi ya fara tasowa. Za su fi sha'awar gani musamman ga fuskoki. Za su kuma fara ƙoƙarin bin abubuwan da ke motsawa.
Za su ƙara sanin sautunan da aka saba da su gami da sanannun muryoyin kamar danginsu. Kuma fara haɗa abin da suka ji da abin da suke gani.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_image_: Haɓaka gani tsakanin makonni biyu da wata ɗaya
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_paragr: Bayan wata uku idanunsu ya kamata su kasance madaidaiciya kuma suyi aiki tare don ƙirƙirar hangen nesa na 3D. Wannan sabon fahimtar zurfin fahimta yana taimaka musu isa ga abubuwa daidai. Za su iya bin abubuwan da ke tafiya da sauri amma yana da wuya a canza gyara daga fuska ɗaya ko abu zuwa wani da sauri.
Suna son kallon abu ɗaya kawai a lokaci guda. Hakanan suna iya fara yin sautinsu na farko masu ma'ana.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_image_: Haɓaka gani tsakanin wata ɗaya zuwa uku
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_6_paragr: Jariri mai hangen nesa na yau da kullun zai yi farin ciki da ganin kofi ko cokali na sha kuma zai iya gyarawa akai-akai tare da bin fuska a nesa na mita 1-2 tare da iya bambanta tsakanin saba da fuskokin da ba a sani ba ta fuskoki da muryoyinsu.
Hakanan za su iya fara ganin abubuwan da suka fi nisa. Ƙaunar son sani, za su fara isa ga abubuwa.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_7_paragr: A cikin watanni 6 zuwa 12, ƙarfin gani yana inganta kuma yana kusa da 6/36. Tazarar da ake kallon fuskoki kuma an gane ta ya kai mita 2. Duk abubuwan hangen nesa suna inganta tare da ingantacciyar isarwa da fahimta.

A wannan shekarun suna ƙara sha'awar hotuna a cikin littattafai da talabijin, kodayake abubuwa na ainihi sun fi sha'awar ƙarfafa su don yin rarrafe da kuma kusa da ranar haihuwarsu ta farko, tafiya zuwa abubuwan sha'awa. Babblings suna tasowa, kuma sautuna za su zama kalmomi na farko a wannan zamani kuma.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_paragr: Da watanni 18, hangen nesa ya zama babba kamar ko da yake har yanzu yana da ɗan ruɗe a yanayin gani na kusan 6/18. Yanzu za su iya gane sunansu kuma suna ƙara amfani da kalmomi.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_image_: Ci gaban gani tsakanin watanni goma sha biyu zuwa goma sha takwas
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_paragr: Bayan watanni 18 na shekaru hangen nesa har yanzu yana buƙatar shekaru da yawa don girma. Matsakaicin gani na manya na yau da kullun zai kasance yana da shekaru 8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_image_: Ci gaban gani tsakanin watanni goma sha takwas zuwa shekaru takwas
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_parag: Bayan shekaru 8 tsarin gani bazai inganta da kyau ga jiyya kamar aikin tiyata na cataract ba. Gane cututtuka da kuma neman magani don haka yana da kyau a yi da wuri a farkon rayuwa.

Ana iya ganin cewa babban adadin ci gaba yana faruwa tsakanin haihuwa da watanni 18 kuma yana ci gaba da sannu a hankali a cikin sauran yara. A wannan lokacin yana da mahimmanci cewa yaron yana da lafiya tare da tsarin gani mara lafiya kuma an ba shi yanayi mai ban sha'awa da ilimi.
Gano farkon bayyanar cututtuka tare da neman magani yana da mahimmanci don taimakawa haɓaka haɓakar gani da haɓaka gaba ɗaya.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_image: Bayan shekaru takwas hoton ci gaban gani

i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_account_security:
Idan kun ƙirƙiri asusu, da fatan za a kiyaye bayanan shiga ku cikin tsaro.
Kuna da alhakin ayyuka akan asusunku sai dai idan kun sanar da mu game da rashin amfani ko matsalar tsaro.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_education_only: Wannan app kayan aikin ilimi ne don tallafawa koyo da bita. Ba shawara na ilimi ba ne, doka ko ƙwararru kuma ba zai iya ba da garantin fasfo na jarrabawa, maki ko kowane sakamako na musamman ba. Zaɓuɓɓukan karatu da yanke shawara sun kasance alhakin mai amfani.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_how_we_use_data:
Wannan bayanan yana taimakawa wajen daidaita ƙa'idar zuwa burin kowane mutum, fahimtar yadda ake amfani da ƙa'idar da haɓaka fasali akan lokaci. Ana iya amfani da shi don tuntuɓar muhimman canje-canje ga ƙa'idar ko asusu.
Ba a taɓa sayar da bayanan sirri ba.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_identity_check: Ana iya buƙatar tabbatar da ainihi kafin a kammala buƙata. Idan duk wani bayani dole ne a adana saboda doka ko dalilai na tsaro, za a bayyana wannan.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_minimum_data: Ana tattara bayanan da ake buƙata don gudanar da haɓaka sabis ɗin kawai.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_service_limits: Manufar ita ce kiyaye app ɗin yana taimakawa kuma abin dogaro, amma babu sabis ɗin da ya dace. Ba za a yi alƙawarin ci gaba da kasancewa ko cikakken 'yanci daga kurakurai ba, kuma app ɗin bazai dace da kowane yanayi ba.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_storage: Ana adana bayanai a kan uwar garken da aka sarrafa da kuma bayanan da hanyar dogo ta bayar. Railway yana ba da masauki da ababen more rayuwa; muna sarrafa yadda ake amfani da bayanai a cikin ƙa'idar kuma muna adana shi kawai tsawon lokacin da ake buƙata.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_third_party: Mun dogara ga amintattun sabis na ɓangare na uku, kamar masu ba da sabis, don gudanar da app. Waɗannan sabis ɗin suna aiwatar da bayanai kawai kamar yadda ake buƙata don samar da abubuwan more rayuwa kuma ba su da izinin amfani da shi don dalilai na kansu.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_uk_law_limits: Har zuwa yadda dokar Burtaniya ta ba da izini, ba mu da alhakin asara kamar alamar da aka rasa, asarar samun kudin shiga ko damar da ta taso daga amfani, ko rashin iya amfani da app ɗin. Babu wani abu a nan da ya cire duk wani haƙƙoƙin da dokar Burtaniya ta bayar.
